Record Class InventoryPage.InventoryItemRow

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
GUI.manager.InventoryPage.InventoryItemRow
Record Components:
id - the inventory_item_id
name - the supply name
unit - one package of the supply, in words, e.g. "bag (1 kg)"
currentLevel - the number of units in stock now
targetLevel - the number of units to keep in stock
lastCount - the level at the last count, or null
lastCountDate - the date of the last count, or null
unitCost - the cost of one unit, in dollars
archived - true if the item is archived
Enclosing class:
InventoryPage
public static record InventoryPage.InventoryItemRow(int id, String name, String unit, BigDecimal currentLevel, BigDecimal targetLevel, BigDecimal lastCount, Date lastCountDate, BigDecimal unitCost, boolean archived) extends Record
One row of the inventory_item table. The id is not shown, but Edit and Delete use it.

Aisha
